scope: Go运行时epoch生成与跨实例状态拒绝

main_package.command: CGO_ENABLED=0 GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off GOTOOLCHAIN=local go test -mod=readonly -count=1 -timeout=120s -tags with_gvisor .

epoch_race.command: CGO_ENABLED=1 GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off GOTOOLCHAIN=local go test -mod=readonly -race -count=1 -timeout=90s -tags with_gvisor -run '^TestAndroidRuntimeEpoch|^TestProductionAndroidRuntimeEpoch' -v .
coverage: 生产身份范围及同实例稳定读取
生成器掩码与保留值重取
无熵/短读/重复保留值失败

contract.lifetime: Go库实例加载一次，不随Activity或engine重建重置
contract.entropy_failure: 终止初始化，无常量或时间戳降级
contract.platform_scope: 该Go包所有平台均生成；熵失败初始化终止也适用于这些平台
contract.reset_boundary: 生产未有coordinator重置；新增重置必须重新核验epoch与revision/generation的ABA合同
